subject: Architecture
title: The Morandi Bridge: Genoa's Tragedy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Morandi Bridge: Genoa's Tragedy.

hook.text: In August 2018, a section of Genoa's Morandi Bridge collapsed during a storm, killing 43 people.

buildup.text: The bridge used a unique cable-stayed design with concrete-encased cables — impossible to inspect visually.

discovery.text: Corrosion had weakened the cables inside their concrete shells for decades without anyone seeing the damage.

twist.text: Italy's bridge infrastructure crisis was well known. Budget cuts had delayed maintenance for years.

climax.text: Renzo Piano designed the replacement — a sleek, inspectable steel bridge built in record time.

punchline.text: Concrete hid the cables. It also hid the failure waiting inside.

quiz.question: Why couldn't inspectors detect the Morandi Bridge's cable corrosion?
options: The cables were too high to reach safely
Concrete encasement hid the cables from visual inspection
Digital sensors were never installed on the bridge
